name: Wojo Live Rosin | Tangerine Limousine
description: This strain's flavor is as whimsical as its name. Creamy orange, tangerine, and grapefruit terps come from Malibu Marsha, while a white grape, champagne back end is provided by the Tropic Driver male. All of that to say Tangerine Limousine basically tastes like a flight of Mimosas, and leaves you just as happy afterwards. She finishes early with dark purple hues that really make the trichomes sparkle. This is definitely one of our sexiest plants and a great day time smoke. If you love orange terps this one is a must try!
